scheme_name: Design Scheme Under MSME Innovative Scheme
other_conditions: Must be a registered micro, small, or medium enterprise.
Must possess a valid Udyog Aadhaar Memorandum (UAM) or Udyam Registration certificate.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance for design projects covering up to 75% for micro enterprises and 60% for small & medium enterprises, up to ₹40 lakh, plus support for student projects up to ₹2.5 lakh.
